patterns.text: Operators in Colombian health name ambient AI scribes (Digital Environmental Scribes; BMJ Best Practice / UpToDate / DynaMed-class decision-support layer) as the highest-impact, lowest-friction first product to adopt.
Patient cycle-of-attention tracking (alerts on lateral needs without full EHR integration; Tensoreye-class) is the second-most-named high-impact gap.
Clinical EHRs in Colombia don't expose APIs; per-clinic integration is bespoke. No national interoperability standard until April 2026 Ministry resolution (operativization unclear).
B2B regulated verticals (health-staffing) don't operate on WhatsApp. Operations run on phone + Excel + private EHRs. Contradicts working hypothesis 'WhatsApp is the OS for LATAM SMBs.'
Operators independently converge on manifesto thesis 'reemplazar el cómo, no el qué' when discussing AI vs. existing systems.
